en: The man on the boards has been waiting for somebody all morning.
He wants the sluice at the weir opened, and he will not say why.
Ask what is at the weir
Jacks. Two, he thinks. He is being careful with the number.
Ask why he will not go himself
Because he is a man who hires. That is not a crime, whatever your face is doing.
Open the gate, come back, and he pays.
He has to be here to pay you, mind. Do try to remember that.
